description: Create a new reusable document template. Templates use HTML/Handlebars markup with a JSON schema defining the expected data fields. Once created, use the returned template ID with `generate_document` to produce PDFs.

description.description: Short description of what this template generates.

is_public.description: Whether the template is publicly visible. Defaults to false.

markup.description: HTML/Handlebars markup for the template body.

name.description: Display name for the template (e.g. 'Monthly Invoice').

sample_data.description: Example data matching the schema, used for previews.

schema.description: JSON schema defining the data fields the template expects.

styles.description: CSS styles to apply to the template.

name: create_template
